Grammar phase done and verified. New module capture_language/snooze.rs: lowercase terminal z:<when> lexing (SnoozeIntent { raw, span, drop }), narrow @route:id! drop claim before target validation, shared conflict/teaching messages. TerminalMarkers.snooze and ParsedCaptureText.snooze ride extraction (markers.rs, target_runs crossing-runs incl. Schedule/Priority/Snooze masking, AggregateMarkers with duplicate refusal); multi-target runs refuse; SpanKind::Snooze spans plus incomplete_snooze/invalid_snooze diagnostics keep strict/editor messages byte-identical (bare z, s:/priority/start/close/session/drop conflicts, existing-children, unsupported kinds, drop-vs-toggle). Drop pre-pass (strict item.rs + editor masked view) yields PomodoroLink+drop; caret ^route:id alias shares the exception. Guard at top of plan_capture_item (capture/plan.rs) refuses every recognized intent with snooze_not_yet_executable_error; nothing writes. GRAMMAR_REVISION 31->32 with test assertions updated (docs prose still says 31; completion_docs owns docs-gen/check). FOR MUTATION: consume ParsedCaptureText.snooze — existing-add = PomodoroLink + body empty + snooze.add (route/block set); drop = PomodoroLink + body empty + snooze.drop; new-task = Task/TaskWithBlockId/bare-Pomodoro + body + snooze.add; remove the plan.rs guard only when every accepted intent reaches a planner branch. Verified: 939 lib capture_language tests incl. 8 new snooze tests + snooze.rs unit tests; 5 new CLI tests/cli/capture/parse_snooze.rs; 2066 capture:: CLI pass with only the 15 pre-existing base failures; fmt clean; clippy gate clean for touched files (one pre-existing failure in untouched complete_block_id.rs). payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Numeric-route snooze-drop preview disagrees with execution — capture-parse -f json -- "@20261125:here!" returns mode=task and body="@20261125:here" while capture correctly drops the active row by basename; the editor masks the bang then falls through the existing alphabetic-route candidate guard. Existing parser code is unchanged by this mutation phase.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Clarify or fix relative snooze rounding — the shared core parser rounds the duration, not the resulting wall clock: at 12:03, +45m resolves to 12:48 and +1h to 13:03. docs/snooze.md says relative targets round upward to a five-minute boundary. Capture intentionally reuses the unchanged core parser; the mutation regression pins its actual result rather than adding divergent capture-only rounding.

Mutation interface handoff for completion/docs: capture now executes existing/new z:<when>, retime, strict @route:id! drop, and ordinary link-now row cleanup through staged core planners. Result schema stays 1 / grammar 33. The optional item.snooze object has action=add|retime|drop|link_now, canonical route including .md, block_id, vault-relative daily_file; add/retime also carry time (HHMM), wake_at (RFC3339), and row (one-based final settled coordinate, omitted if a later item removes it). Drop/link_now omit time/wake_at/row. Unrelated captures omit snooze. Existing add/drop use kind=snooze; new tasks and ordinary link-now retain their ordinary kind. Human add/retime preview says snoozed until HH:MM and has no fictional Pomodoro block. All existing task/link construction and core time semantics are reused. No memory or documentation files edited by this phase.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Repair pre-existing full-check failures — full check ToolRun d9f6d1470d4fa55a51b0d07d48d1089f passed formatting/lint and 13,162 tests but failed 43 lib + 55 CLI tests. LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (bob-cli-q5.3.1.land, source HEAD 292d60c0):
Reviewed every note on .1 (4), .2 (6), and .3 (2), with sase_new_task duplicate searches, recent-task sweep, and active-epic causal review.
1. q5.3.1.1 #1 manual_contains: declined as resolved by 71f7b670; complete_block_id.rs now uses ids.contains(&"dup").
2. q5.3.1.1 #2 (15 capture CLI failures): corroborated on bob-cli-q4 as DISCOVERED ISSUE, with proposing bead and exact grouping. They are the capture subset of its existing 17 settlement failures.
3. q5.3.1.1 #3 contains two distinct reports: WISPr kicker corroborated via +1 on bob-cli-q9, and september_shaped_vault_finishes_fast fail/pass evidence via +1 on bob-cli-gz. Relayed phase observations, no fresh lander test run claimed.
4. q5.3.1.2 #1 numeric-route snooze-drop editor/execution mismatch: retained as this epic's remaining work, not a standalone task. The new drop pre-pass in editor_parse.rs masks ! and recursively hits the ordinary alphabetic-route guard. Installed grammar-33 bob reproduces mode=task/body=@20261125:here while dry-run successfully returns snooze.action=drop; current source contains the same path.
5. q5.3.1.2 #2 relative rounding: routed as DISCOVERED ISSUE to outer bob-cli-q5; core parse_relative_delta rounds the offset, and q5.1 note #2 already flags that interpretation. Capture correctly reuses it. Outer q5 must reconcile shared semantics/vector/docs; no capture-only rule or duplicate task.
6. q5.3.1.2 #4 and q5.3.1.3 #1 (same 98-node baseline set): decomposed into 80 drawer-cutover nodes corroborated on bob-cli-ph, 17 settlement nodes corroborated on bob-cli-q4, and WISPr on bob-cli-q9. Clean-base evidence is phase .2 ToolRuns d9f6d1470d4fa55a51b0d07d48d1089f/549282d9b014e9ca187b04e3ed57d52c and .3 comparison at ae78dbb2; no fresh full gate claimed here.
No new task beads were needed; all distinct non-epic proposals are already resolved or owned. Implementation/handoff notes checked: the mutation adapter removed the grammar execution guard, dispatches every accepted intent, retains schema 1, refreshes final row positions after settle, and completion/docs consume the additive contract. Remaining work and final verification are specified in a medium tale; do not close yet.

LAND AUDIT / REMAINING WORK at 292d60c0 (fetched origin/master matches): reviewed original and child capture plans, original parent phase q5.3 final DECISIONS, all child scopes/notes, epic commits 1b386638/ae78dbb2/712d69d9, and actual grammar/editor/dispatch/snapshot mutation/core planner/result/completion source and tests. Audited other commits since epic creation/first epic commit: tie handling/docs/lint, drawer/caret docs and fixtures, b8678657/bbcae8e0 planned-today readers, 4a812173 plan forecast, and 292d60c0 settlement acceptance. No merge conflict or competing implementation found. Add cross-feature regression coverage using actual capture-created rows in the remaining tale.
